plugin.name: OCum Ascended synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes OCum Ascended RaceMenu CumOverlays and its vaginal/anal OStim equip-object meshes between Skyrim Together players. v0.35.0 uses one common RaceMenu body-relink pipeline in both free-standing and physical-furniture scenes: each CumOverlays change queues BodyUpdate, OverlayUpdate and NodeOverride in RaceMenu's native order, then reapplies the authoritative overlay materials. This repairs Body [OvlN] overlays that remain linked to an obsolete or incorrect body geometry across OStim scene transitions and supersedes the previous furniture-only/hard-reinstall repairs. Requires OCum Ascended on both clients.

plugin.name: PPA - Procedural Penis Animations synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes PPA runtime penetration targets between Skyrim Together scene participants, including per-stage target site and explicit target actor in multi-actor scenes. v0.33.3+ also reproduces PPA's native active-runtime refresh after remote target writes. Recommended by default and still user-deselectable. If PPA is not installed or the runtime DLL is unsupported, OStim Together disables this optional integration safely. Requires PPA on both clients for synchronization.
